text_block_list.text:
Aiming to become the strongest in the 
world, El Condor Pasa descended upon the 
ring known as the Twinkle Series!

Surrounded by formidable friends like 
Special Week and Grass Wonder, all in 
order to become the "World's Strongest 
Umamusume"—

Declaring that she will spread her wings 
to the world, El Condor Pasa shouted 
toward the vast open sky.
